repos_data.description: A CLI inspector for the Model Context Protocol

A lightweight service that enables AI assistants to execute AWS CLI commands (in safe containerized environment) through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Bridges Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-aware AI tools with AWS CLI for enhanced cloud infrastructure management.
Give hands to AI. MCP server to run shell commands securely, auditably, and on demand.
CLI and MCP server for DoubleTick email read tracking
open source CLI to control Anythink from the command line

A flexible platform that provides Docker & Kubernetes backends, a lightweight CLI (mcpt), and client utilities for seamless MCP integration. Spin up servers from templates, route requests through a single endpoint with load balancing, and support both deployed (HTTP) and local (stdio) transports — all with sensible defaults and YAML-based configs.
Command line interface for MCP clients with secure execution and customizable security policies
A Bitbucket CLI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server in Go.
This project implements an MCP server to interact with ionos cloud resources.
